caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on a cream-colored paper and depicts three objects within a bordered rectangular frame. On the right side is a detailed drawing of a pair of long-handled tongs, which have a loop at the end of each handle, with one handle ending in a rounded, flat element, and the other ending in a pointed element, with the two handles joined at a pivot point near the scoop or spoon-like end. To the left, within a smaller rectangular box, is a simplified side and front view of the same pair of tongs, showing the handles and the pivot mechanism. In the lower right quadrant of the main bordered area, there is a detailed drawing of a circular coin or medallion featuring an emblem with a shield, crossed branches, and what appears to be an eagle or bird at the top. The composition is monochromatic, consisting entirely of grayscale tones from the pencil on paper.
title: Wafer Iron
